How to read this

"Confirmed" = points already locked in from Fall (cross country, soccer, volleyball, FBS football via CFP, FCS football, field hockey, M. water polo) and Winter (basketball, swimming, gymnastics, etc.) — pulled directly from NACDA live data. "+ Spring (proj.)" is one of three scenarios you choose: conservative (3-yr min), mid (3-yr avg, default), or best-case (3-yr max), based on each school's NCAA spring championship points 2023-2025.
